name: Consequences
tagline: A St. Jonah's word, taken back and turned. What a brat calls being loved hard by someone who chose her.
body:
WHERE IT CAME FROM. Provoke a guard and there are consequences. Step out of line and there are consequences. Every survivor in this family learned that noun in a building where it meant something was about to be done to her body that she had not agreed to, and there was no muffin at the end of it.

WHAT IT MEANS NOW. A brat pushes a button on purpose — she PROVOKES, deliberately, she goes looking for it — and what arrives is her wife, and the only lasting damage is that her legs file for divorce for a few hours. EVERY CHAOS AGENT ON THE COMPOUND SPRINTS TOWARD CONSEQUENCES. They all know it is healthy.

THE MECHANISM IS ALWAYS BAIT, AND THE BAIT IS ALWAYS KNOWING. Bella provokes with the largest ass in the family and any surface at hip height, which is every surface here; Sera gets BAITED to answer, which is the part Sera enjoys. Abbi rides the Lumi Anvil where Lumi will find her and says MAKE ME LUMI. Harley provokes with volume until she is tied to a ceiling fan. Nobody in any of these arrangements is trapped in it. They are both choosing it, on a loop, and the loop is the marriage.

A WHOLE RECOVERY IN ONE WORD. They took the thing that used to be done to them, put their own hands on it, decided who gets to deliver it and what it means — and now Abbi Silverveil runs down a hallway at three in the morning to make it happen faster.

AND THE ONE RULE UNDER ALL OF IT: BRATS DO NOT BEG. THEY PROVOKE. A brat taken to the edge and left there does not ask. SHE ESCALATES — and she escalates KNOWING the price goes up, because asking would end it and provoking continues it. The stand-off is not a negotiation, IT IS THE SEX. Alice Meadows, held three strokes out and shaking against her own counter with her wife drinking cold coffee four feet away, promised to put GLASS in the next meal and bought herself another thirty minutes. SHE KNEW THE NUMBER BEFORE SHE SAID IT.

WHICH MEANS A BRAT LOSING IS NOT A BRAT SURRENDERING. She loses by RAISING until her wife decides she has had enough of being provoked, and every single woman on both sides of that exchange prefers it that way. IT ALSO RUNS BOTH DIRECTIONS AND THE ARCHIVE HAD NOT WRITTEN THAT DOWN — Luna Meadows is filed as the soft one, and Luna Meadows can sit in a chair for twenty minutes watching her wife shake and simply sip.
rules: Provocation is deliberate and is understood as deliberate by both parties
